title: Helga NDE 2414
content: Before I had the experience, I broke down at my desk and I remember the arrival of the emergency physician and the ambulance. Then I remember a black tube, which turned into a brick tunnel, and on the walls of the tunnel, there were old oil paintings, which depicted scenes of my life. While I was crawling through the tunnel 'on all fours', I felt like I was being crushed by an unbearable burden. I could see a faint, but very bright light at the end of the tunnel. I was pushed forwards by the thought that that was exactly where I had to be. The nearer I came to this light, the lighter the burden that was on me seemed to become. When I got to the light I reached into it with my right hand first, and it was pleasantly warm - in contrast to the tunnel which was cold as ice (I was sweating anyway). As I stepped through the light everything became very bright, airy and wonderfully beautiful around me, and I lost the burden that was previously threatening to crush me. I felt happy and free, as if I was lying in a fragrant meadow with a slight breeze on a warm summer's day. In the next moment I was lying in my grave, I could clearly see the walls next to me. My husband and my daughter were standing above the grave and were completely devastated. I called to them that they shouldn't worry, I was fine and I would wait for them. After that my husband tossed in the rose he held in his hands, but my (at the time) thirteen year old daughter refused to cast hers in, even though I repeatedly asked her to. Suddenly I was back in the tunnel and another black tunnel appeared to my right. My consciousness slowly returned, and I could hear the doctor and the nurse saying excitedly, she's coming around again. Later they explained to me where I was and what had happened and that I should write down my experiences. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 09/25/2003 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Bin auf Arbeit zusammengebrochen und am nächsten Tag auf der Intensivstation wachgeworden How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I can't, I have had a similar level of consciousness before in my dreams At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? As I stepped into the light and as I lay in the grave. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Can't say. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. In the light everything was much clearer and brighter, in the tunnel normal outlines and colors. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes A brick tunnel, never seen this before or after - the stones were brownish, and there were pictures in gold frames on the walls depicting people and circumstances of my preceding life. I didn't have time though to really look at the pictures. Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes My husband and my daughter. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Brighter than anything I've ever seen before, but it wasn't blinding. It was pleasant and sort of white, and it exuded peace and warmth. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm Als ich ins Licht trat, man kann es nicht beschreiben so schön war es, muß eine andere Dimension gewesen sein What emotions did you feel during the experience? In the tunnel - overwhelming, psychological dead-end. In the light - free and relaxed and filled with unbelievable peace and happiness. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Past flashed before me, out of my control In pictures, circumstances of my life with other people, but I can't describe any details. Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Liberal keins Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Liberal keins Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain Since I was five years old I have been having dreams that would come true again and again, concerning me and also others. I was a so-called sleepwalker. I was often afraid, because I had no influence on the course of events. Have also read cards on and off. Almost a year after my NDE I read the cards again and found myself in a kind of trance, though I was fully conscious, and I read the cards so precisely and knowledgeably for the lady I was reading for, that I was shaken up and bewildered myself, and since then I haven't touched the cards or done anything similar. Since that time, I've also been pretty much left in peace by my 'dreams'. I have substantially contributed to this myself. I have withdrawn my own sleep. Only with a television or a radio turned on. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? I am not afraid of my own death anymore because I have already lain in my own grave. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes About twelve hours. I talked to my doctor about it, and he suggested I write it down. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes Only the usual 'talk' about the light, but no detailed information. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I am certain that my experience was real, because of my previous dreams and 'visions' (positive and negative). I am also an atheist by the way, doesn't sound logical, but all I know is that there is more out there than our 'usual level of consciousness' will allow. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real See previous answer to same type of question. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Crawling through the tunnel 'on all fours' and feeling 'crushed by an unbearable burden'; later 'pushed forwards by the thought that that was exactly where I had to be.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as 'very bright, airy and wonderfully beautiful' and like 'lying in a fragrant meadow with a slight breeze on a warm summer's day.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Collapsed at work; remembered emergency physician and ambulance; woke the next day in intensive care.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Described self as atheist; 'Liberal keins' for religion before/after.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Included a scene of being in her grave observing husband and daughter above it; then returned to the tunnel and regained consciousness hearing medical staff.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with life-scenes on walls → light/beautiful realm → sudden grave scene with husband and daughter → back in tunnel with another black tunnel appearing → gradual return of consciousness hearing doctor/nurse.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to the tunnel after the grave scene; another black tunnel appeared to the right.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Sudden shift from the bright realm to lying in her grave, seeing the grave walls, with husband and 13-year-old daughter standing above; daughter refused to throw in her rose. Another black tunnel appeared to her right upon returning to the tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “In the next moment I was lying in my grave, I could clearly see the walls next to me.”
